'''Din Suub''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]] he served in the [[V'buk Squadron]] among his fellow Sullustans during the [[Battle of Ilum]].
